strata.description: Acute destructive industrial fire disasters with independent official/incident reports in 2025. Exactly one primary chip per incident.
strata.contingency_rule: If clear Sentinel-2 scenes in 2025 are < 15, expand temporal window to 2024 or allocate shortfall to STR-2 (Other Thermal Source).

strata.description: Continuous industrial gas flaring, active coal seam smoldering, operational brick kiln clusters, thermal power stations.
strata.contingency_rule: Scale from known registries (World Bank GGFR, SentinelKilnDB, Coal India, CEA).

strata.description: Wildland forest and woodland fires across diverse Indian ecological biomes.
strata.contingency_rule: Stratify across Central (MP/CG), Northeast (Assam/Meghalaya), Western Ghats, and Himalayan foothills.

strata.description: Crop residue and field burning across Rabi (spring) and Kharif (autumn) harvest windows.
strata.contingency_rule: Sample across Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, and Madhya Pradesh intensive agricultural parcels.

strata.description: Refineries, chemical zones, and power plants under normal, clear, non-burning operation.
strata.primary_data_source: OpenStreetMap industrial polygons, Central Electricity Authority registry
strata.contingency_rule: Essential for training false-positive rejection of complex industrial infrastructure.

strata.description: Unburnt natural forest, harvested agricultural soil, and cloud-shadow edge cases.
strata.primary_data_source: Low-confidence FIRMS detections and clear-sky background land-cover tiles
strata.contingency_rule: Provides hard negative background diversity across terrain types.

strata.description: The audited 15-chip pilot dataset (ds08_pilot_v1) held out permanently as an immutable benchmark.
strata.contingency_rule: Invariant: Must never be partitioned into training or validation folds.

NORTH.administrative_domain: Punjab, Haryana, HP, J&K, Ladakh, Uttarakhand, Delhi, Chandigarh, Western UP
NORTH.key_landscapes: Indo-Gangetic stubble burning, Himalayan pine forests, NCR brick kilns

CENTRAL.key_landscapes: Dry deciduous forest fires, Singrauli-Korba coal/thermal industrial belt

SOUTH.administrative_domain: Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Puducherry, Lakshadweep
SOUTH.key_landscapes: Western Ghats evergreen forests, Deccan plateau agriculture, coastal refineries

EAST.administrative_domain: Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Odisha, Sikkim, Assam, Northeast states, Andaman & Nicobar
EAST.key_landscapes: Jharia/Raniganj coal seam fires, Northeast shifting cultivation (jhum), tea gardens

WEST.administrative_domain: Rajasthan, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Dadra & Nagar Haveli, Daman & Diu
WEST.key_landscapes: Gujarat petrochemical corridor (Hazira, Jamnagar, Dahej), arid scrub fires, ports

temporal_matching_tiers.expected_signature: Active flaming combustion front, high SWIR saturation, localized smoke plume
Ignition or early burnout stage, dispersing smoke, developing burn scar
High-contrast post-fire burn scar, ash deposit, residual cooling embers
Post-fire scar validation and environmental damage assessment

spatial_partition_rules.pilot_handling: Permanently held out as independent calibration benchmark
